subtitleNullable: King County, WA Election Night Data
descriptionNullable: This dataset provides precinct-level election night results for the November 5, 2024 General Election in King County, Washington. It includes detailed vote counts and related information for each precinct, offering a granular view of the election outcomes across the county. This dataset is essential for election analysts and researchers interested in understanding voting patterns and electoral performance at a local level.
